summary: #320 priority: can primitive thisness distinguish two unrestricted pure acts? Related/context lookup reused PartFreePlurality, RootMultiplication (#697 fork) and the Joint single-mover carrier. Their represented essence map cannot ask whether a thisness is something in the being, so a typed real-determination interface (Has, Pure) was added. Unrestricted perfection plus strict pure actuality constructively leave only bare plurality (pureActPluralityIsBare); a real thisness is then a pure perfection and is shared (thisnessIsPure, uniqueFromRealThisness); identity of real indiscernibles excludes bare plurality (uniqueFromRealIndividuation). Controls: the unchanged part-free model is the bare rival; non-pure thisness (Scotist-shaped) fails only strict purity; thisness counted pure fails only unrestricted perfection (ordinary immaterial simplicity); identity of real indiscernibles exceeds uniqueness; real thisness is not an equivalent of uniqueness; positive witness. Both uniqueness bundles are inclusion-minimal in this profile. Rejected: letting Has contain identity predicates (trivializes individuation); reading the existing formal-or-eminent every-perfection as real possession of every determination; deriving strict purity from absence of potency. All four results zero-axiom and Comparator/NanoDa accepted locally. frontier-diff: no change. FOLLOW-UP 2026-11-07: narrower bridge PurelyDeterminedIndiscerniblesIdentical (bare difference needs a non-pure determination in one of the two beings). It suffices with the two pure-act premises (uniqueFromPureIndiscernibility; three omission controls), is strictly weaker than identity of real indiscernibles (registered strengthens; strict on a Black-style carrier where located non-first beings are barely distinct), and fails with determination-free inert rows. Renaming test: if only first movers are purely determined, then under the two pure-act premises it is equivalent to at-most-one, so it supports uniqueness only if defended as a general principle about numerical difference. All three results zero-axiom, Comparator/NanoDa accepted locally; frontier-diff no change. Necessary-root connection (2026-11-07): the three pure-act premises restated for actual roots of the selected grounding relation (separate statements; actual rootness is not first-mover status) give STMT-UNIQUE-NECESSARY-ACTUAL-ROOT together with the four whole-roster existence premises, by re-indexing the first-mover theorems (firstIffRoot) rather than restating them; the narrower bridge works the same way. This is a second uniqueness route to the necessary-root endpoint, disjoint from the maximum-in-being bundle apart from the shared existence premises. Omission controls on one-world profiles: bare roots, non-pure and pure thisnesses, and an empty carrier each break uniqueness; one-root positive witness. Leaf derivation (2026-11-07): every actual root lacks the three represented limiting principles (per-root rerun of ROOT-WITHOUT-LIMITING-PRINCIPLE); one open bridge over all beings (unlimited beings have only pure determinations) then derives strict pure actuality both at the actual roots and for first movers, the latter from the existing Prima Via simplicity and first-being statements. Reachability check: STMT-UNIQUE-NECESSARY-ACTUAL-ROOT does not reach STMT-CATHOLICISM-TRUE; STMT-AT-MOST-ONE-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER does. Definition-linked source statements (2026-11-07): SCG I.28 whole power, ST I q.4 a.2 and SCG I.42 encoded as weaker supported siblings; two routes (whole power; q.7 infinity, sharing a designated-root-route premise) derive unrestricted perfection for first movers and actual roots; SCG I.42 gives at-most-one from unrestricted perfection and strict pure actuality and is strictly weaker than the narrower bridge.
blocker: Bare numerical difference among purely determined beings survives without the narrower bridge. Its defense must be a general account of numerical difference (required frame of multiplicity versus merely accompanying frame); under the natural background that only first movers are purely determined, no independent test case distinguishes the answers, so this is a judgment that cannot yet be encoded. Strict pure actuality and unrestricted perfection over real determinations remain open; they now reach the necessary-root endpoint only in their root-indexed form, and no bridge identifies actual roots with first movers. Unrestricted perfection is now derived, but through open analyst bridges (no limitation to own being; infinity to every pure perfection); the limitation bridge is open and unattributed (classical support: ST I q.7 a.1, deferred).
